provenance.firmware: GC Services, O731 (per accompanying memory-map notes)

notes: The Falco table is 0x7B entries (0x00..0x7A), 3 bytes per entry.
Selection of a 3-byte column is controlled by modifier state and configuration.
The bytes in columns 0,1,2 are internal codes, not uniformly ASCII.
For a printable key with byte 2 = FF, Ctrl produces the chosen printable byte AND 1F.
Key-dependent personality overrides and a function row swap can change the RAM table.
Measured physical keys are explicitly marked; other names obtained by matching token values to standard PC table or visible ASCII.
